items:

the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,

Wear your safety helmet, 
 safety shoes .... etc
Switch off the C.B
The opening mechanism has been secured against unintentional movement
The control voltage supply lines have been disconnected
Safety helmet & safety shoes

Portable air blower,
 torque wrenches
Screw driver with extension spection

Filter's Hammer,
 Cotter driver
Benz assembly tool

Carry out the annual procedures stated in the MPIS 
 document no. CB-110-r0

Replace the clutch by pull remind (figure 7/5 a, b)
 Motor 13401 with pinned freewheel clutch 13410 from eccentric Shaft 13470.

Remove and replace spiral brace 13419, then pull
 clutch coupling 13411 off transmission shaft and replace, and Check that the freewheel clutch 13410 function correctly.

Replace the eccentric shaft 
 (figure 7/5 g, b), Disconnect screw
 connection 13487/13489 remove.

Replace spring washers 13487 Pull
 Bearing bracket 13481 off eccentric shaft 13470 detach the roller Chain 13464 from sprocket wheel lift out eccentric shaft 13470 
 & replace
Adjust the necessary play by shifting the bearing bracket & then tighten

Replace the ball sockets ( figure 7/5 d, f, h ) open locking device of 
 ball socket 13286
Dismantle circlip 13284, remove plain washer 13287, replace both washers

Pull ball socket off spherical gudgeon 13931 respect 13941 & remove rod 13280 
 respect 13281
Measure length L1 respect L2 of rod 13281 respect 13280
Replace the cylindrical traction springs (figure 7/5 g)

Detach both cylindrical traction springs 13725 from carrier 13701 of lock 
 13700 and replace fit traction springs first to both 13729 & then hook into 
 carrier for mounting position refer to (figure 7/5 g)
Measure the timing test (open - close) cycle
Measure the contact resistance.

Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists 
minor maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed after five years as 
indicated by Y5 in the above title block.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Wear your safety helmet, 
 safety shoes .... etc
Switch off the C.B
The opening mechanism has been secured against unintentional movement
The control voltage supply lines have been disconnected
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet & safety shoes
Portable air blower,
 torque wrenches
Screw driver with extension spection
Filter's Hammer,
 Cotter driver
Benz assembly tool
Work to be Carried Out
Carry out the annual procedures stated in the MPIS 
 document no. CB-110-r0
Replace the clutch by pull remind (figure 7/5 a, b)
 Motor 13401 with pinned freewheel clutch 13410 from eccentric Shaft 13470.
Remove and replace spiral brace 13419, then pull
 clutch coupling 13411 off transmission shaft and replace, and Check that the freewheel clutch 13410 function correctly.
Replace the eccentric shaft 
 (figure 7/5 g, b), Disconnect screw
 connection 13487/13489 remove.
Replace spring washers 13487 Pull
 Bearing bracket 13481 off eccentric shaft 13470 detach the roller Chain 13464 from sprocket wheel lift out eccentric shaft 13470 
 & replace
Adjust the necessary play by shifting the bearing bracket & then tighten
Replace the ball sockets ( figure 7/5 d, f, h ) open locking device of 
 ball socket 13286
Dismantle circlip 13284, remove plain washer 13287, replace both washers
Pull ball socket off spherical gudgeon 13931 respect 13941 & remove rod 13280 
 respect 13281
Measure length L1 respect L2 of rod 13281 respect 13280
Replace the cylindrical traction springs (figure 7/5 g)
Detach both cylindrical traction springs 13725 from carrier 13701 of lock 
 13700 and replace fit traction springs first to both 13729 & then hook into 
 carrier for mounting position refer to (figure 7/5 g)
Measure the timing test (open - close) cycle
Measure the contact resistance.
